name: ZCA_INTERVIEWS
description: This table is used to store interview data, generated by Intelligent Advisor.

columns.name: INTERVIEW_ID
columns.description: Interview ID to uniquely identify the record. Auto-generated.

columns.name: INTERVIEW_NUMBER
columns.description: Interview number to uniquely identify the record. Auto-generated based on document sequence.

columns.name: INTERVIEW_NAME
columns.description: Name of the intelligent advisor interview.

columns.name: AUTHORING_INTERVIEW_NUMBER
columns.description: Interview number to uniquely identify the fusion interview record.

columns.name: INTERVIEW_TYPE
columns.description: Specifies the type of Interview. Possible values so far are Sales Call Guide, Sales Assessment and etc.,

columns.name: SOURCE_OBJECT_NUMBER
columns.description: PUID of the top level object associated with the interview.

columns.name: SOURCE_OBJECT_CODE
columns.description: Name of the top level object associated with the interview.

columns.name: SOURCE_OBJECT_ID
columns.description: Id of top level object associated with the interview.

columns.name: INTERVIEW_DRAFT
columns.description: Draft interview data. This allows a user to continue from the saved draft.

columns.name: INTERVIEW_DATA
columns.description: Submitted interview in JSON format. This will contain submitted questionnaires and responses.

columns.name: INTERVIEW_STATUS
columns.description: Status of the interview, In Progress or Completed.

columns.name: INTERVIEW_DATA_LANG
columns.description: Language in which interview has been submitted.

columns.name: INTERVIEW_SCORE
columns.description: Contains the score calculated from an sales assessment template.

columns.name: INTERVIEW_OUTCOME
columns.description: Contains the outcome calculated from a sales assessment template.

columns.name: OWNER_RESOURCE_ID
columns.description: Owner Resource ID of the user who created the record.

columns.name: ATTACHMENT_ID
columns.description: Attachment ID of the Interview summary, added to the top level object.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
